description: Picks mdxcn next to prose. In Notion, Linear, or a README, pastes the framed ASCII from the docs MDX tab (dashed box, [ TITLE ], glyphs — keep the fence). In React or MDX that can register the parent, wraps markdown children in the component. In a Comark app, writes a ::graph-* block with YAML props. In a Knap template, pipes props through a graph_* filter. Never invents SVG, Mermaid, Recharts, canvas, or homemade ASCII. Use when explaining a refactor, incident, postmortem, tradeoff, pull request, sprint, or migration; when writing a README or markdown doc; when the user mentions mdxcn, ASCII diagrams, framed charts, GraphFlow, GraphTimeline, Comark, or Knap; or when a write-up would scan faster with a figure.
